photos.title: The Blue City
photos.caption: Indigo-washed houses of old Jodhpur packed below Mehrangarh Fort.
photos.alt: Blue-painted houses of Jodhpur's old city seen from above, tightly packed under a clear sky.
photos.author: Nico Crisafulli from USA
photos.commonsTitle: File:Blue houses in Jodhpur seen from Mehrangarh Fort, India set-473 (5581471860).jpg

photos.title: Mehrangarh Fort
photos.caption: The 15th-century fort of the Rathore rulers of Marwar, rising 125 m above Jodhpur.
photos.alt: Carved sandstone palace walls and balconies of Mehrangarh Fort in Jodhpur.
photos.author: Adityavijayavargia

photos.title: Ghanta Ghar & the old city
photos.caption: Jodhpur's clock tower above Sardar Market, with Umaid Bhawan Palace on the horizon.
photos.alt: Rooftop view of Jodhpur with the clock tower on the right and Umaid Bhawan Palace in the far distance.
photos.author: Jakub Hałun
photos.commonsTitle: File:20191210 Widok z dachu w Dźodhpurze 1556 8059.jpg

photos.title: Umaid Bhawan Palace
photos.caption: The Art Deco palace of the Jodhpur royal family, built 1929–1943 on Chittar Hill.
photos.alt: Umaid Bhawan Palace on a hill above Jodhpur, seen at a distance from Mehrangarh Fort.
photos.author: Prashantkovhal

photos.title: The Marwari safa
photos.caption: A bright saffron safa (turban), the everyday crown of Marwar, worn here at the Mehrangarh museum.
photos.alt: An elderly man in a saffron Rajasthani turban and white kurta sits cross-legged in a room at the Mehrangarh Fort museum.
photos.author: Schwiki
photos.commonsTitle: File:An old man in traditional Rajasthani dress in Mehrangarh Fort Museum.jpg

photos.title: Ghoomar
photos.caption: The swirling women's dance of Marwar, performed in flared ghagras at weddings and festivals.
photos.alt: Ghoomar dancers in brightly coloured ghagras and veils twirl in a row on a stage.
photos.author: Aali Jain

photos.title: Kalbelia
photos.caption: The serpentine dance of the Kalbelia community, listed by UNESCO as Intangible Cultural Heritage.
photos.alt: Two Kalbelia dancers in black and multicoloured flared skirts spin outdoors.
photos.author: Kenneth Lewis

photos.title: Kathputli puppets
photos.caption: Rajasthani string puppets, carved and dressed by hand, still tell old ballads at fairs.
photos.alt: A Rajasthani kathputli string puppet with a painted wooden face and a red and gold costume.
photos.author: Manojmeena

photos.title: Camel fair at dusk
photos.caption: Camel herders head home across the fairground at the Pushkar fair.
photos.alt: Black-and-white photo of camels and a herder silhouetted against the low sun on the Pushkar fairground.
photos.author: Sudipta Dutta Chowdhury

photos.title: Bandhani
photos.caption: Tie-dyed odhnis in saffron, red and green, the dotted textiles worn for Teej and weddings.
photos.alt: Bright bandhani tie-dyed fabrics in orange, red and green stacked at a market stall.
photos.author: Piyush Kumar

photos.title: Dal baati churma
photos.caption: Marwar's signature meal: baked wheat baati with ghee, panchmel dal and sweet churma.
photos.alt: A steel plate of dal baati churma with baked wheat dumplings, lentil curry and crumbled sweet churma.
photos.author: Harshmander Rastogi

photos.title: The Thar desert
photos.caption: Shifting dunes of the Great Indian Desert, which covers much of western Rajasthan and Marwar.
photos.alt: Rippled sand dunes of the Thar Desert under soft light.
photos.author: Vyacheslav Argenberg
photos.commonsTitle: File:Thar Desert, India, Huge shifting sand dunes.jpg
